How Releasing Pledged Gold Works

When gold sits in a loan, interest keeps growing while the gold earns nothing. If the gold's value today is more than the loan dues, releasing it and selling it can leave you with money in hand instead of a growing liability — and stop the risk of losing the gold entirely if the loan goes unpaid.

The process is straightforward: bring your loan receipt or pawn ticket and one photo ID. We calculate the gold's value at the day's rate, go with the settlement figure the lender confirms, help you settle and release the gold, and buy it from you — you keep the difference between the value and the dues.

If the loan amount turns out to be more than the gold's value, releasing may not benefit you, and we will tell you that clearly. There is no charge for the valuation or the advice, and no obligation. Please note: we help you settle a loan you already have — we do not offer loans or financial advice.

What We Accept

  • Gold pledged with banks and NBFCs

How It Works

How to Sell Your Gold in 3 Easy Steps

1

Visit Our Branch

Bring your gold, silver or diamond items and one valid photo ID to our South Extension branch — 1515, Upper Ground Floor, Wazir Nagar, South Extension Part I, Kotla Mubarakpur, New Delhi 110003. No appointment needed.

2

Get Your Gold Evaluated

We test purity on the German Karat Meter in front of you, weigh the item at the counter, and give you a fair, transparent price at the day's market rate — the full calculation explained.

3

Receive Instant Payment

Accept our offer and get paid in the same visit via cash, cheque or bank transfer, with a proper receipt. If you don't accept, you take your items back — free, no obligation.
